title: Planted q-ary Noisy Dual-Intersection False-Negative Bridge: Weight-Stratified True-Codeword Survival, Universal Spurious Noise-Invariance, and Primal Minimum-Distance Scaling

theorems.name: Exact Weight-Power Survival Law and False-Negative Rate on B
theorems.statement: Under m i.i.d. noisy QFT_q^(tensor n) dual samples u = (v + xi) mod q at noise rate gamma in [0, 1], any planted codeword b in B of Hamming weight wt_H(b) survives all m zero-syndrome checks with exact probability S_planted(wt_H(b); q, gamma, m) = (1/q + ((q-1)/q) * (1 - gamma)^(wt_H(b)))^m.

theorems.name: Universal Noise-Invariance of Non-Planted Spurious Survival on F_q^n \ B
theorems.statement: For every non-planted vector x in F_q^n \ B, every noise rate gamma in [0, 1], and every m >= 1, Pr[x in B_hat_(m, gamma)] = q^(-m) identically, so E[|B_hat_(m, gamma) \ B|] = (q^n - q^d) q^(-m) is independent of gamma.

theorems.name: Primal Minimum-Distance Survival-to-Spurious Frontier
theorems.statement: For any gamma in (0, 1), the m-sample survival-to-spurious ratio Pr[b in B_hat_(m, gamma)] / q^(-m) = (1 + (q - 1)(1 - gamma)^(wt_H(b)))^m over non-zero b in B \ {0} is maximized at minimum-weight planted codewords wt_H(b) = d_min(B) = min_(b in B \ {0}) wt_H(b).
